PAYMENT AND PERFORMANCE BOND

Bond No. SB-2026-44817
Penal Sum: $4,250,000.00

KNOW ALL PERSONS BY THESE PRESENTS, that we, Ridgeline Constructors LLC, a Colorado limited liability company, as Principal, and Cascadia Surety and Casualty Company, a Washington corporation authorized to do business in Colorado, as Surety, are held and firmly bound unto the Jefferson County School District R-1, as Obligee, in the penal sum of FOUR MILLION TWO HUNDRED FIFTY THOUSAND AND NO/100 DOLLARS ($4,250,000.00), for the payment of which we bind ourselves, our heirs, executors, administrators, successors, and assigns, jointly and severally.

WHEREAS, Principal has entered into a written contract with Obligee dated February 2, 2026 for the construction of the Meadowbrook Elementary School addition (the "Contract"), which is incorporated here by reference;

NOW, THEREFORE, the condition of this obligation is such that:

1. Performance. If Principal promptly and faithfully performs the Contract, then this obligation is void; otherwise it remains in full force. On Obligee's declaration of Principal default and termination of the Contract, Surety shall promptly and at Surety's expense either complete the Contract itself, arrange for completion by a contractor acceptable to Obligee, or pay Obligee the amount for which Surety is liable, not exceeding the penal sum.

2. Payment. Principal and Surety shall promptly pay all claimants who furnished labor, materials, or equipment used in the performance of the Contract and who have not been paid, up to the penal sum.

3. Claimant Notice. A claimant not having a direct contract with Principal must give written notice to Surety and to Principal within ninety (90) days after the last day on which the claimant furnished labor or materials.

4. Suit. No suit on this Bond may be commenced after one (1) year from the date on which the claimant last furnished labor or materials, or from the date on which Principal ceased work on the Contract, whichever is earlier, except where a longer period is required by Colorado law, in which case that period governs.

5. Changes to the Contract. Surety waives notice of any change, extension of time, alteration, or addition to the Contract, and no such change releases Surety.

6. Aggregate Liability. Surety's aggregate liability under this Bond, for both performance and payment obligations, shall not exceed the penal sum stated above.

SIGNED AND SEALED this 2nd day of February, 2026.

PRINCIPAL: RIDGELINE CONSTRUCTORS LLC
By: /s/ Teodora Vasilenko
Title: Managing Member

SURETY: CASCADIA SURETY AND CASUALTY COMPANY
By: /s/ Bernard Achike-Ozoemena
Title: Attorney-in-Fact
